hooks.name: Mr T

action.prompt:
Review the changes associated with the saved file.

Determine whether the change affects project behavior,
architecture, APIs, database structure, configuration,
or other information that should be documented.

If the change is meaningful, update the appropriate
project documentation.

Do not modify application source code.

Do not document trivial formatting or whitespace changes.

Do not invent functionality that is not present in the
actual project changes.

hooks.description: Whenever meaningful project code changes, automatically ask Kiro to document what changed.
